* **Applying to GTA6**: Players can secure these discounted gift cards and load them onto their PSN accounts to purchase the Ultimate Edition of *Grand Theft Auto 6* for PS5 at a reduced effective cost.

Because this particular offer is explicitly flagged as a one-day-only event, timing is crucial. Just make sure to stick to verified and trusted retailers to ensure your account security remains uncompromised.

## Editor's Take

Every little bit helps when budgeting for top-tier gaming experiences. While saving $15 won't break the bank, using a discounted PSN gift card to pick up the GTA6 Ultimate Edition is a no-brainer for players who were planning to buy it anyway. Just be sure to act fast before the deal disappears.
